zh: 前缀是按长度从短到长依次出现的，第一个满足条件的前缀就是最早的那个，不需要任何复杂结构。
从左到右累加前缀和，每加一个数就检查一次是否 ≤0，第一次满足时立即给出当前下标；注意本题使用 0 起始下标。
total=0；对 i=0..n-1，total+=a[i]，若 total≤0 就输出 i 并结束；循环结束仍未满足则输出 -1。前缀和可能超出 32 位，用 64 位整数。
en: Prefixes appear in order of increasing length, so the first one that satisfies the condition is the earliest; no special data structure is needed.
Accumulate the prefix sum from left to right, check after each addition whether it is <= 0, and report the current index the first time it is; note that this problem uses 0-based indices.
Set total = 0; for i = 0..n-1 add a[i] to total and, if total <= 0, print i and stop; if the loop finishes without that happening, print -1. Prefix sums can exceed 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Accumulate the prefix sum and, as soon as it is <= 0, return the current 0-based index.

## Correctness

The i-th addition gives exactly the sum of the prefix 0..i; checking in increasing index order, the first success must be the earliest one, and if no check succeeds there is no such prefix.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1) apart from the input.
